messages:
jin: Heads-up — aurora-lite-1 int8 bring-up shows weird U+200B (zero-width space) insertions around CJK punctuation when there's an embedded Arabic segment. Float16 baseline clean.

rohit: Reproduced on my laptop with the eval harness. Minimal example below.
```
input: "今天早上去市場買蘋果。داخل السوق: تفاح."
baseline (f16): "今天早上去市場買蘋果。داخل السوق: تفاح."
int8 (aurora-lite-1): "今天早上去市場買蘋果​。داخل السوق: تفاح."
# note the ZWSP (U+200B) inserted before the full stop after 蘋果
```

anya: :eyes: That's sneaky. chrF on zh-Hant mixed-arabic testset drops ~7.1% vs f16 (same checkpoint, different quant path).

eval-bot: quick-run summary: dataset=zh-Hant-mixed-arabic, metric=chrF, f16=0.62, int8=0.576 (delta -7.1%). samples=1200. p-value<0.01

sam: Can you share repro script? I'll run a byte-level decode and tokenizer id dump. Try this:
```
python tools/repro_zwsp.py --model aurora-lite-1 --quant=int8 --case "mixed_cjk_arab"
# prints token ids + utf8 bytes
```

rohit: Bisect points to commit abc1d9e — that's where we switched to the fused int8 layernorm kernel. Rolling that out of the int8 build now to confirm.

jin: Filing bug RINF-3421 with examples, eval artifacts, and sample diffs. Assigning to eng-ml/quant. /cc @anya @sam

anya: For short term, can we add a regression unit that checks for U+200B adjacent to CJK punctuation in mixed-script samples? Add to the smoke/regression suite.

sam: Will add a quick check and a tokenizer-id assertion. Patch incoming :hammer_and_wrench: 

rohit: After rollback to previous int8 kernel the regression disappears in smoke. Next steps: deep-dive on quant rounding + tokenizer boundary edge-cases. :mag:

jin: Thanks all. Keeping thread open until PR + tests land.
